Card Q&A.a: No, even if this effect didn't suspend the target, it can still give it "can't unsuspend."
Card Q&A.q: If this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect couldn't suspend a Digimon, does that mean it can't give that Digimon "can't unsuspend"?

Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation.  Upon a check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.  For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend until their turn ends. Then, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, this Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and +5000 DP for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
